title: Clap Clap
blurb: Two claps. Not three, not a round of applause. Two, spaced far enough apart that the silence between them does the talking. This is the most passive-aggressive noise a human body can produce, and it functions as commentary rather than celebration: recognition offered at the exact minimum required to avoid accusations of rudeness. Use it for sarcastic congratulation, or as the opening of a slow clap that everybody can already tell is going somewhere unpleasant. Well done. Truly. Genuinely, well done.
origin: Two isolated claps, used as sarcastic applause.
